description: Kyocera于2000年推出的便携相机。配备21mm to 42mm f/4.9 to 7.3。快门速度2 seconds to 1/300 second.。使用Drop in auto load, auto advance, auto rewind, mid-roll rewind.。感光度DX ISO range 50 to 3200。5-Point Auto Focus。

specs.胶片/画幅: Drop in auto load, auto advance, auto rewind, mid-roll rewind.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in with auto flash mode, red eye reduction, fill flash, flash off, and night mode.
